forecast_results.prediction: AWS segment margin compresses 100-300bp in FY2026 vs FY2025 (35.4%) as D&A from the $131.8B capex wave flows through Technology & Infrastructure costs
forecast_results.evidence: Full-year window settles Feb 2027, not yet elapsed. Both reported FY2026 quarters run the opposite way: Q1 2026 AWS margin 37.7%, Q2 2026 39.4% ($16.6B EBIT on $42.2B revenue, +37% YoY, fastest in 18 quarters) against the 35.4% FY2025 base. For the full year to still compress even 100bp, H2 2026 would need to average roughly 30% margin — a sharp reversal of the observed trend. [Amazon Q2 2026 results, IR release, 2026-07-30]

forecast_results.prediction: Q2 2026 consolidated EBIT lands in the $23-25B range (above $23.4B consensus mid-point) driven by AWS acceleration and advertising strength, AND Q3 guidance midpoint holds at or above $24B
forecast_results.evidence: Testing the recorded confirmation_trigger literally (Q2 EBIT >= $24B AND Q3 guidance midpoint >= $24B): Q2 2026 operating income was $27.5B (+43% YoY), above $24B. Q3 2026 guidance is $22.5-26.5B operating income, midpoint $24.5B, also above $24B. Both legs of the confirmation trigger clear. Note: the prediction's own PROSE text ('$23-25B range') was itself too conservative -- actual Q2 EBIT of $27.5B exceeded the stated range's top end by ~10%, which the run's own 2026-08-01 ad-hoc review scored as 'falsified on the letter' of the narrower range language. This review scores against the recorded machine-readable confirmation_trigger, which Q3 guidance (unavailable as of the 08-01 review) now also confirms. [Amazon Q2 2026 results, IR release, 2026-07-30; Amazon Q2 2026 earnings call, Q3 guidance, 2026-07-30]

risk_results.risk: Killer risk -- D&A from the capex wave arrives faster than revenue and compresses AWS margins below 30%, driving EBIT to $60-65B and fair value to $146 or below
risk_results.evidence: The opposite occurred in both quarters reported since decision date: AWS margin 37.7% (Q1 2026) then 39.4% (Q2 2026) against a 35.4% FY2025 base, with consolidated EBIT running at a $27.5B quarterly rate and Q3 guided to $22.5-26.5B. The kill criterion (Q2 AWS margin <30% AND T&I growing >25% YoY without revenue acceleration) did not trigger -- AWS revenue accelerated to +37%. [Amazon Q2 2026 results, 2026-07-30]
